verdict.rationale: Claude.ai's chat interface, Claude Code, and agent skills/tool-use let users operate the product entirely via natural-language instructions (e.g., 'Chat on web, desktop, and mobile,' 'Hand off and schedule tasks,' tool use, and Skills that convert instructions into specialist workflows). This is core to the product across both consumer and API/agent surfaces. missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence specifically validating natural-language command reliability/UX (community evidence cited is about pricing/rate-limits/model quality, not NL command operation), and no explicit walkthrough of NL-driven task execution end-to-end.
